name: sirenward
description: Open-source browser extension against distraction: site blocking, YouTube filter, lock mode – fully local.

scripts.test: node tools/i18n.js --check && node --test tests/core.test.js tests/features.test.js tests/background.test.js tests/background-features.test.js tests/i18n.test.js && node tests/static-scan.js
scripts.test:e2e: node tests/e2e.test.js && node tests/locale.test.js && node tests/blockpage.test.js && node tests/csp-probe.test.js
scripts.build: node tools/build.js && node tests/static-scan.js dist/chromium && node tests/static-scan.js dist/firefox
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run test:mutation && npm run build && node tests/e2e.test.js dist/chromium && node tests/locale.test.js dist/chromium && node tests/blockpage.test.js dist/chromium && node tests/csp-probe.test.js dist/chromium
